description: Get the full nutrient profile for one food by FDC ID. Returns all available nutrients (or a filtered subset via the nutrients[] param) with optional per-portion scaling. Use usda_search_foods to discover FDC IDs. Provide quantity + unit to scale all nutrient values from per-100g to the specified portion (e.g. quantity=200, unit="g" → per-200g values). Use unit="serving" to scale to the food's first defined portion weight. Narrow nutrients[] to specific IDs to reduce response size for focused queries.

fdcId.description: FDC ID of the food. Use usda_search_foods to discover IDs.

nutrients.description: Filter to specific nutrient IDs (e.g. [1003, 1004, 1005, 1008] for protein, fat, carbs, energy). Use usda_list_nutrients to look up IDs. Omit to return all available nutrients.

quantity.description: Amount of food to scale nutrient values to. Must be positive. When provided, unit is required. Omit for per-100g values (FDC database native basis).

unit.description: Unit for quantity. "serving" uses the food's first defined portion weight. Required when quantity is provided.

name: usda_get_food

allPortions.description: All named portions for this food.

items.description: A named portion for this food.

dataType.description: FDC data source: SR Legacy, Foundation, Survey (FNDDS), or Branded.

description.description: Full USDA food name (e.g. "Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, raw").

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The FDC ID does not exist in the database. `quantity_without_unit`: quantity is provided but unit is omitted. `no_portion_data`: unit="serving" was requested but the food has no portion data. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

foodCategory.description: USDA food category (e.g. "Poultry Products"). Absent for some branded items.

ingredients.description: Ingredient list from label. Branded items only.

nutrients.description: Nutrient values for this food, per 100g or scaled to the requested quantity.

items.description: A single nutrient entry with ID, name, amount, and unit.

amount.description: Nutrient amount — per 100g, or scaled to quantity+unit if provided.

percentDailyValue.description: Percent daily value from product label. Branded items only.

publicationDate.description: Date this food entry was published in FDC.

scaledTo.description: Scaling basis when quantity+unit were provided. Absent when returning per-100g values.

gramWeight.description: Gram weight resolved from quantity+unit — all nutrient values are per this many grams.

quantity.description: Numeric quantity provided in the request.

unit.description: Unit provided in the request (g, oz, lb, kg, or serving).

servingInfo.description: First available portion definition, if present.

title: Get USDA Food
